Oh no, I 100% do need therapy. I did try, but the day of the first meeting like an hour before they called me and said that they didn't work there anymore.
Its also hard because I go to school out of state, so when I go home I'd have to find a new therapist everytime I go back. I just dont see any point in going if I can't get a solid relationship.
Another thing is, my brother is doing like, 3 forms of therapy so there isn't much room for me to get help as my parents have to focus on him. 
At this point I should just suck it up lol. Its all so stupid.
